identity.title: Community Health Volunteer Prenatal Checkup Program

course.claim: Volunteer can independently conduct a standard prenatal home-visit checkup and correctly flag when a case needs referral to a clinic.
course.non_claims: Does not authorize the volunteer to diagnose, prescribe, or treat any complication directly.

live_problem.situation: Rural households often skip prenatal checkups until a complication is already advanced, because the nearest clinic requires a half-day trip.
live_problem.purpose: A volunteer can catch warning signs early, at the household, before a trip to the clinic becomes urgent.

learner.prior_knowledge: Volunteers are literate community members with no formal medical training; some have informal caregiving experience.
learner.barriers: Cannot travel to a central training site often; program must run mostly in-field, over several weeks, with a supervising nurse present periodically.

opens: a checkup is a fixed checklist against a threshold, not a judgment call about how the mother 'looks'
changed_questions: does this specific reading cross the referral threshold?

routes.question: Does this reading cross a published referral threshold?
routes.criteria: every threshold on the checklist is checked and compared, referral triggered if any is crossed

capability.overall: Volunteer can complete a full prenatal home-visit checklist and correctly decide refer-or-continue.
capability.human_return: With the supervising nurse absent, volunteer completes a real household visit and makes a correct refer-or-continue call against the published thresholds.

content.must_know: Every threshold on the referral checklist and what crossing it means.
content.must_do: Perform a full real household visit and complete the checklist.

sessions.learner_action: Volunteer conducts 2 household visits with the nurse observing but not intervening.
sessions.evidence: 2/2 checklists fully completed with correct threshold comparisons, nurse confirms no missed flags

sessions.learner_action: Volunteer conducts a real household visit alone; nurse reviews the completed checklist afterward, not during.
sessions.evidence: checklist matches nurse's independent post-hoc review, no missed referral flags

assessment.claim: Volunteer can independently complete a prenatal checkup and correctly decide refer-or-continue.
assessment.task: Conduct a real, unsupervised household visit and complete the checklist.
assessment.observation: Whether every threshold was checked, and whether the refer-or-continue decision matches the nurse's independent post-hoc review of the same readings.
assessment.criteria: All checklist items completed; refer-or-continue decision matches nurse's review with zero missed referral flags.
assessment.warrant: A missed referral flag is the exact failure this program exists to prevent, so nurse-agreement on referral decisions is the load-bearing evidence, not checklist completion alone.
assessment.assistance_condition: unassisted during the visit; nurse review happens only afterward, not during

closure_pack: phone contact for the supervising nurse
